items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, I can’t – I’m sure I have, but I’m not that familiar with his work.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think that’s who it was. He was bad.
How about Dennis Chambers? Have you heard him?

No, I can’t – I’m sure I have, but I’m not that familiar with his work. There’s so many of them. You know what I say too a lot of times? I say I sure am glad I’m not no young guy coming up now. I swear I’m glad I was there when I was than come through this, because they’ve got so many – everybody, brrrrryat. I’d pack up the drums. Some of the guys say, brrrrrrrrr, brrrrrrrr. It’s out of a clear blue sky, before they get warm. I say,
